payout_quote: Starting July 14th, 2025, the person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $150 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred (Referred Person) to OnPath CU who registers for the offer, opens a new OnPath CU personal checking account and completes the other requirements within the time specified in the offer.
steps: Be a current OnPath Federal Credit Union member in good standing; register for the ReferLive Checking Account Program
Share your friend's/family member's name and email address (or your referral link)
Friend registers for the offer via the referral email/link, becomes an OnPath member, and opens a new personal checking account
Within 60 days of account opening, friend makes 15+ debit card transactions of at least $10 each AND receives direct deposits totaling at least $250
You receive a $150 Visa Reward Card within 4-6 weeks
catches: Cap: up to five (5) $150 Visa Reward Cards per calendar year ($750)
Friend must register for the offer via the referral link BEFORE opening the account
Friend requirements are steep: 15 debit purchases of $10+ each plus $250+ in direct deposits within 60 days
Reward is a Visa Reward Card (not cash), delivered 4-6 weeks after qualification; cards may be reported as income to the IRS
Only one account per referred person qualifies; referrer must be a current member in good standing
Offer subject to change without notice; $150 rate applies during promotional period starting July 14, 2025
biggest_catch: Your friend must do serious work within 60 days — 15 debit-card purchases of $10+ plus $250 in direct deposits — or you get nothing.
eligibility: Current OnPath FCU members in good standing; referred friends must be new OnPath members opening a personal checking account
timing: Friend qualifies within 60 days of account opening; Visa Reward Card delivered in 4-6 weeks
